units.project: Source Code - Soroban Tricorn Bridge v240725
units.titles: Insufficient authorization validation allows adversaries to steal bridge out funds
units.known_address_notes: Coinspect 2024 report: Soroban (Stellar) bridge in BoostyLabs/tricorn-smart-contracts (fix commits 7d5c488, 9cbe4fd); finding is missing authorization on the bridge-out path. No contract ID (C...) anywhere in the PDF. Repo is 404 via GitHub API, tricorn.xyz serves an invalid TLS certificate (curl CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED) and Jina 422, Wayback holds only a 2024 redirect plus a 8.8 KB JS chunk with no C-address, StellarExpert search API 404 / explorer search page returns no contract. Deployed So

OtterSec 2024 review ('Missing Access Restrictions') of StakeUp's stUSDC suite; the public repo stakeup-protocol/stakeup-contracts matches scope exactly (src/staking/StakeUpStaking.sol, src/token/{StTBY,WstTBY,StakeUpToken}.sol, src/messaging/{WstTBYBridge,BridgeOperator}.sol, RedemptionNFT, RewardManager, LayerZero OApp wiring in script/WireOApps.s.sol). No deployments/ or broadcast/ address book; script/DeployFull.s.sol is fully commented out and only carries Arbitrum-Sepolia testnet constants

Code4rena contest 44 (2021-10-20..22) for Tally (tally.cash, the community-owned wallet later renamed Taho): scope is 'Tally Swap', the 0x-based DEX aggregator - contracts/swap/Swap.sol, utils/Math.sol, governance/{EmergencyGovernable,EmergencyPausable}.sol. The contest repo has no deploy script, address book or .env with a deployed instance, and the modern tahowallet/extension routes swaps through the 0x API (background/lib/0x-swap.ts, .env.defaults) rather than a Tally-owned contract. No verif
